reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend and skip-occurrence helpers with a holidays parameter and adds one isNonWorkingDay predicate used everywhere.

duplication.why: No new copies; the non-working-day rule is defined once, though each caller threads config.holidays by hand and the parallel filter/move chains in getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange remain.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts beside the weekend helpers; the type field goes in RecurConfig and parseRecurDate carries it into the schedule data.

scope.why: Touches only the weekend-handling helpers, their callers, the type and tests.

maintainability.why: Clear single definition with sensible bounds helpers, but names still say 'weekend' for a broader rule and the lookahead/shift bounds are heuristic formulas a maintainer must reason about.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every weekend site (getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange, schedule-template) goes through isNonWorkingDay/getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

one_place.where: isNonWorkingDay and getDateWithSkippedWeekend in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, used by getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template.ts.
